blocks.text: Identify which part failed: login screen, Labwc, Waybar, dock, launcher or one application. Keep work saved. Use Help's optional system information view for bounded status evidence, then inspect the relevant guide.

systemctl --user --failed --no-pager
systemctl --user status labwc-session.target waybar.service crystal-dock.service --no-pager

Read the owning service logs, then use the existing component-specific restart action once when appropriate. If the session itself is unhealthy, save work and sign out normally. A stale configuration, unavailable package and denied access require different fixes.
Do not disable security policy, start duplicate services, delete session directories or enable global Xwayland as a generic desktop repair.
